verdict.rationale: Mastercard documents an official MCP server in its Developers Agent Toolkit. Agents such as Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Windsurf can connect to it for contextual answers and dynamic code generation from current API specs, and Open Finance integration is an explicit example use case. The server appears scoped to developer documentation and code assistance rather than live Open Finance operations, and the pack has no setup or configuration details. Missing for 10: MCP tools that invoke live Open Finance APIs (accounts, balances, transactions), documented connection and auth setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.
